images.title: Add two stick piles by joining
images.purpose: Shows the simplest stick arithmetic without number names: adding two collections by putting them together.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two small bundles of sticks on the left joined by a plus sign, an arrow, and one combined bundle on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: a bundle of exactly 3 upright teal (#0072B2) sticks, then a plus sign, then a bundle of exactly 4 upright amber (#E69F00) sticks. One dark arrow pointing right, labelled join. Right: one bundle of exactly 7 upright sticks, 3 teal and 4 amber, standing side by side with no gaps. No numerals anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
